purpose: Four unapproved card-detail wireframe alternatives without microcards, using the same fictional six-member epic as the earlier card-based set.

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: static product-design wireframe, landscape desktop comparison image.
Input image: style reference ONLY for grayscale typography, board backdrop and fictional data. Create a NEW layout. Do not reproduce the reference's microcards.
Primary request: open-backlog item details WITHOUT any microcards. Flat text navigation and uncluttered readable document design.
Style: crisp monochrome desktop UI wireframe, white surfaces, black text, hairline gray separators, restrained gray fills. Clean sans serif, large legible interface text, strong hierarchy, generous readable line spacing. Straight-on screen, no perspective. Board may remain faintly visible behind a centered detail dialog; backdrop board cards are allowed ONLY as subdued background. No tiny illegible annotation. Landscape around 3:2.
Data for fair comparison: fictional epic W-60 Checkout refresh; exactly six members, two done. Member order: W-61 Order summary — Done; W-62 Address form — Done; W-63 Payment errors — In progress; W-64 Confirmation — Ready; W-65 Receipt email — Waiting on W-63; W-66 Checkout review — Ready. Selected member is W-63 Payment errors (item 3 of 6).
Selected item text: title "W-63 Payment errors"; metadata "In progress · High priority · Build · Checkout". Section "Why", sentence "Make failures clear and recoverable." Section "Acceptance", three plain bullets: "Explain what failed", "Keep entered details", "Offer a clear retry".
If relations shown, render ordinary underlined text links grouped by relationship: "Depends on" with "W-61 Order summary" and "W-62 Address form"; "Unblocks" with "W-65 Receipt email"; "Related" with "W-66 Checkout review". Parent link "W-60 Checkout refresh" must be separate.
Actions: "Copy prompt", "Open file", visible "Close". Ordinary toolbar buttons are allowed.
Critical constraints: NO microcards in the detail surface; NO mini bordered panels for individual related/member items; NO card-shaped navigation tiles; NO carousel or card strip. No colored chips. Rows and relation links have no individual rounded outlines or shadows. Simple text statuses. Navigation click targets still generously spaced. No interactive checkboxes for acceptance. Do not add decorative charts, fake prose or development details. This is an unapproved design exploration.
Composition: caption outside screen at top "D / Reading first", subtitle "A quiet document, with relationships as links." Create a centered moderately narrow dialog occupying about two thirds of the board width. One reading column with comfortable line length; NO sidebar. At top put a small underlined parent epic breadcrumb on left and Close on right. Then large item title and simple inline metadata. A compact Copy prompt and Open file action row. Article Why and Acceptance with ordinary bullets. At bottom a hairline separator then a compact definition-list section "Connections": left column relationship labels, right column ordinary underlined links, no containers. Lower footer has underlined "← Previous member", central "Item 3 of 6", "Next member →". The whole reading document is the visual focus. Leave comfortable breathing room but no giant empty blocks. Show no full member list in this option.

images.concept: Phone / Plain list and reading view
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: two-state mobile UI wireframe comparison, landscape canvas with two tall phone screens side by side.
Input image: grayscale style and fictional data reference ONLY. Do not reproduce its microcards.
Primary request: open-backlog epic browsing and item reading WITHOUT any microcards. Caption above phones "Phone / Plain list and reading view"; subtitle "Simple rows for browsing; a clear path back while reading."
Style: crisp monochrome vector-like raster wireframe, clean white phones with thin gray perimeter, large black sans-serif text, ample text spacing, no perspective, no decorative device hardware. Label left phone "1. Browse epic" and right phone "2. Read member".
Left phone: top "Epic overview" and visible Close; large heading "W-60 Checkout refresh", text "2 of 6 done". Exactly SIX generously spaced flat full-width list rows divided only by light horizontal rules. Each row has ID/title on first line, text status on second, small right chevron. Content: W-61 Order summary / Done; W-62 Address form / Done; W-63 Payment errors / In progress · Viewing; W-64 Confirmation / Ready; W-65 Receipt email / Waiting on W-63; W-66 Checkout review / Ready. Selected third row has pale continuous full-width gray fill and black left line. No individual bordered boxes, NO rounded tiles, NO microcards, NO two-column grid.
Right phone: underlined back breadcrumb "← Checkout refresh", visible Close. Compact "Item 3 of 6 · All 6 items" with All 6 items an underlined link. Large title "W-63 Payment errors". Inline metadata "In progress · High priority", then "Build · Checkout". Compact toolbar Copy prompt / Open file. Why: "Make failures clear and recoverable." Acceptance: three plain bullets "Explain what failed", "Keep entered details", "Offer a clear retry". Relationship groups as plain underlined text links, no surrounding containers: "Unblocks" then "W-65 Receipt email"; "Related" then "W-66 Checkout review". Bottom separated footer with simple underlined "← Previous" and "Next →"; scope label "Epic order". All text fits, legible at mobile scale; prioritise comfortable tap spacing. No card strip/tray/mini bordered panels; only the outer phones have borders. No acceptance checkboxes, no colors, no code snippets, no rem/px annotations.
